purpose: M0/M1 traversal starter. No mechanical-combat acceptance; geometry and character are original neutral proxies.

actor.rationale: Original compiler fixture; not an Aya reconstruction. Neutral gauntlet stats support traversal only. PE HP/PE/AT/growth/skills remain unresolved.

equipment.rationale: Identity and equipped slots only. Empty traits deliberately supply no weapon/armor calibration; magazine and tune-up are not implemented.

boundaryText: Starter boundary: the basement fuse/key loop is the next build. The elevator is offline. No combat is active.

geometry.rationale: Vendored original lit gauntlet kit, with existing beauty/collision/walk authority. Four route areas reuse two proxy rooms; layouts/camera positions are not source-measured.
